summary: Improve cash positioning, forecasting and treasury controls through practical exercises. Explore the five-day foundation course.
lede: Corporate treasury management coordinates cash, funding, payments and financial risk through day-to-day routines. For treasury analysts, cash managers and finance staff taking on treasury duties, the course develops practical ways to position cash, build rolling forecasts, reconcile bank balances, apply payment controls and plan liquidity, with exercises in basic foreign-exchange exposure mapping and treasury reporting.
audienceIntro: This foundation course suits professionals who handle company cash, funding, payments or related finance controls and need practical treasury routines they can apply at work.
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with finance operations, cash transactions or accounting records is helpful. No programming is required; exercises use spreadsheet-based treasury schedules.
